title: Visualizing miRNAs in adult skeletal muscle by hybridization _in situ_
protocol: Assemble the following master mix per reaction in an MM tube for miRNA sense and antisense RNA probe generation: Add 2.0 ml of 10X Transcription Buffer, 1.0 ml of 10 mM ATP, 1.0 ml of 10 mM CTP, 1.0 ml of 10 mM GTP, 0.5 ml of 10 mM UTP, 0.5 ml of 10 mM digoxigenin-12-UTP, 2.5 ml of DNA Template at 0.5 mg/ml concentration, 2.0 ml of T3/T7 RNA Enzyme Mix, 1.0 ml of SuperaseIn, and 4.5 ml of nuclease-free water.
Incubate the reaction at 37°C for 90 minutes.
Add 1 ml of DNAse I to the tube and incubate at 37°C for 15-30 minutes to remove the DNA template.
Add carrier tRNA, 2 ml of 5.0M ammonium acetate, and 3 volumes of 100% ethanol to the mixture.
Mix well and put the tube on ice for 20 minutes.
Spin at maximum speed in a 4°C microfuge for 30 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and wash the pellet once with 70% ethanol.
Spin at maximum speed in a 4°C microfuge for 5 minutes, then discard the supernatant.
Air-dry the pellet for 5 minutes.
Dissolve the pellet in 20 μl of DEPC-treated water.
Check the concentration of the sample on a spectrophotometer and dilute to 0.1-0.2 μg/μl.
Run 2-4 μl of RNA probes on a 1.5% agarose gel to check size and integrity of RNA probes.
Take the slides from -80°C.
Fix the section in 4% paraformaldehyde (in PBS) for 20 min, in a sterile jar, and in the hood.
Wash the sections in PBS for 2 x 10 min.
Prepare X ml of Proteinase K buffer and store it on ice.
Add 1 μl/ml of proteinase K (20 mg/ml) to the Proteinase K buffer just prior to use.
Apply approximately 200 μl Proteinase K solution on each slide, covering the sections.
Incubate each slide for 5-7.5 min at room temperature.
Post-fix the section in 4% paraformaldehyde (in PBS) for 20 min, in a sterile jar, and in the hood.
Wash the sections twice with PBS for 5 min each.
Rapidly wash in DEPC-treated dH₂O.
Prepare 250 ml of 0.1M TEA using 3.35 ml of a 7.5M TEA stock solution.
Place the slides in a slide-rack and immerse them in TEA in a large staining jar with a magnet stirrer.
While stirring, add acetic anhydride to a concentration of 0.25% (625 μl) and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Wash the slides in PBS for 5 minutes.
Wash the slides in 0.85% NaCl for 5 minutes.
Dehydrate the slides sequentially in 30%, 50%, 70%, 85%, 95%, and 100% ethanol (2 minutes in each solution).
Let the slides dry in a horizontal position for at least one hour.
Add pre-hybridization buffer to the sections and incubate at 30-40°C for 2-4 hours.
Mix probe into 1 ml of hybridization buffer to achieve a final concentration of about 300-500 ng/ml.
Aspire pre-hybridization buffer from slides, add mixed hybridization solution (100 μl per slide), cover tissues with parafilm, and hybridize at 37-40°C overnight in a moist chamber.
Rinse slides with pre-warmed 4XSSC solution at 37-40°C.
Remove parafilm from slides.
Wash slides in 2XSSC at 37-40°C for 20 minutes in a water bath with shaker.
Treat the slides with 400 units/ml RNase A at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Wash slides in 1XSSC at 40°C for 10-15 minutes.
Wash slides twice with 1XPBST for 5 minutes each at room temperature.
Incubate with alkaline phosphatase-coupled anti-digoxigenin antibody diluted 1:4000 in 1X PBST, adding 100 μl per slide to the sample.
Incubate at room temperature for 4 hours.
Wash slides with 1XPBST in a staining jar 4 times for 30 minutes each or overnight.
Wash slides with Developing Buffer for 20 minutes.
Develop color by mixing 4.5 ml NBT, 3.6 ml BCIP, and 1 ml levamisole in 1 ml of Developing Buffer.
Use 200 μl of developing solution to cover tissue sections.
Add Developing solution on slides.
Incubate slides flat to allow precipitate to form.
Observe signal detection periodically under a microscope.
Stop reaction when good staining quality is achieved.
Wash with TE buffer for 5 min at room temperature to stop reaction.
Wash the slides in 1XPBS for 20 min at room temperature.
Rinse with ddH₂O.
Mount slides with water-based mounting medium.
View hybridization signals under a light microscope.
